label: help_sim_datagen_mimic
command: docker exec s2r-sim s2r-entrypoint python -m sim.datagen.mimic --help

Isaac Lab Mimic source segmentation and retargeting with the shared S2R
recorder. The upstream DataGenerator owns selection, rigid transforms,
interpolation and subtask sequencing. This module supplies the selected arm's
IK and the task's stage annotations. Imports of runtime environment classes
remain lazy until Kit has been launched. Ordinary Mimic is used;
SkillGen/CuRobo is not required.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config_path CONFIG_PATH
  --source {mimic}
  --arm ARM
  --scene SCENE
  --task TASK
  --variant VARIANT
  --unit UNIT
  --destination DESTINATION
  --repo_id REPO_ID
  --report REPORT
  --attempts ATTEMPTS
  --episodes EPISODES   Stop after this many accepted episodes; zero runs all
                        attempts
  --max_steps MAX_STEPS
  --warmup_steps WARMUP_STEPS
  --fps FPS
  --seed SEED
  --starts_dir STARTS_DIR
  --start_options START_OPTIONS
                        Per-run object start region: frame, xy_min, xy_max,
                        yaw_deg
  --initial_joints_sim INITIAL_JOINTS_SIM
                        Optional fixed initial action-joint positions,
                        radians/metres in manifest order
  --start_joint_jitter_rad START_JOINT_JITTER_RAD
                        Seeded initial revolute-arm joint variation; the robot
                        base stays fixed
  --expert_options EXPERT_OPTIONS
                        Task-specific expert options as a JSON object
  --control_offset CONTROL_OFFSET
                        Optional EE-local TCP offset in metres, JSON vector
  --ik_backend {arm,bounded}
  --ik_integral_gain IK_INTEGRAL_GAIN
                        Bounded servo-error correction per second; zero
                        disables
  --ik_max_integral_bias_rad IK_MAX_INTEGRAL_BIAS_RAD
  --ik_max_integral_bias_m IK_MAX_INTEGRAL_BIAS_M
  --ik_orientation_weight IK_ORIENTATION_WEIGHT
                        Relative weight of each controlled orientation axis in
                        library IK
  --ik_orientation_tolerance_rad IK_ORIENTATION_TOLERANCE_RAD
                        Allowed tool orientation error at a waypoint; task
                        success remains task-owned
  --ik_damping IK_DAMPING
                        Damped least-squares regularization in library IK
  --solver_njmax SOLVER_NJMAX
                        Constraint capacity for complex imported collision
                        geometry
  --solver_nconmax SOLVER_NCONMAX
                        Contact capacity for complex imported collision
                        geometry
  --diagnostic_images   Save RGB at waypoint boundaries beside the report
  --disable_fabric
  --headless
  --source_dataset SOURCE_DATASET
                        Successful S2R dataset with datagen_meta annotations
  --input_file INPUT_FILE
                        Alternatively, an SDK-annotated Mimic HDF5 source
  --mimic_options MIMIC_OPTIONS
                        JSON object overriding task.mimic options
  --diagnostic_trace    Save existing frame annotations, post-step signals and
                        joint buffers beside --report

launcher arguments:
  Arguments for the KitLauncher. For more details, please check the
  documentation.

  --livestream {0,1,2}  Force enable livestreaming. Mapping corresponds to
                        that for the `LIVESTREAM` environment variable.
  --xr                  Enable XR mode for VR/AR applications.
  --device DEVICE       The device to run the simulation on. Can be "cpu",
                        "cuda", "cuda:N", where N is the device ID
  --visualizer VISUALIZER, --viz VISUALIZER
                        Visualizer backends to enable as CSV (e.g.,
                        kit,newton,rerun,viser).
  --verbose             Enable verbose-level log output from the
                        SimulationApp.
  --info                Enable info-level log output from the SimulationApp.
  --experience EXPERIENCE
                        The experience file to load when launching the
                        SimulationApp. If an empty string is provided, the
                        experience file is determined from the resolved
                        visualizer and XR settings. If a relative path is
                        provided, it is resolved relative to the `apps` folder
                        in Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab (in that order).
  --deterministic       Request reproducible rendering (see KitLauncher docs).
  --kit_args KIT_ARGS   Command line arguments for Omniverse Kit as a string
                        separated by a space delimiter. Example usage:
                        --kit_args "--ext-folder=/path/to/ext1 --ext-
                        folder=/path/to/ext2". A single Kit argument works in
                        both forms: --kit_args "--ext-folder=/path/to/ext1" or
                        --kit_args=--ext-folder=/path/to/ext1.
  --anim_recording_enabled
                        Enable recording time-sampled USD animations from
                        IsaacLab PhysX simulations.
  --anim_recording_start_time ANIM_RECORDING_START_TIME
                        Set time that animation recording begins playing. If
                        not set, the recording will start from the beginning.
  --anim_recording_stop_time ANIM_RECORDING_STOP_TIME
                        Set time that animation recording stops playing. If
                        the process is shutdown before the stop time is
                        exceeded, then the animation is not recorded.
  --max_visible_envs MAX_VISIBLE_ENVS
                        When set, caps the nums of envs shown in the launched
                        visualizers.
